name: Pickle Finance ControllerV4 fake-jar swap
summary: ControllerV4.swapExactJarForJar validated only approvedJarConverters for the call targets and never checked that _fromJar/_toJar were Pickle jars, so an attacker-deployed fake jar turned the controller into an arbitrary-call proxy that withdrew the real DAI strategy's cDAI.
notes: The missing jar validation in swapExactJarForJar is part of ControllerV4's immutable direct runtime, created by this transaction.
Pickle reported 19,759,355 DAI drained from the pDAI jar; the reported whole-token amount is valued at stablecoin par.
The official incident report publishes the drained DAI quantity rounded to a whole token.
